headline: Argentina Gas Production Reaches Historic High in 2026 on Vaca Muerta
summary: Between January and September, Argentina extracted 40.3 billion cubic meters of gas, marking an unprecedented volume for the period driven by unconventional exploitation in Vaca Muerta.
why: Vaca Muerta is a massive shale gas and oil reserve in Argentina, and rising production is a key driver for the country's energy self-sufficiency and potential export growth.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Record gas production boosts domestic energy supply and economic prospects.
